features.title: Email and SSO authentication
features.description: Users can sign in and maintain secure sessions across all clients.
acceptance_criteria: Users can sign in with email plus password and OAuth provider.
Session tokens are refreshed without forcing re-login.
Sign-out invalidates sessions across all platforms.

features.title: Workspace and project management
features.description: Users can create workspaces and projects with role-based access.
acceptance_criteria: Workspace owner can invite members and assign roles.
Project list is consistent across all platforms.
Unauthorized users cannot access restricted projects.

features.title: Task CRUD lifecycle
features.description: Users can create, edit, assign, and complete tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Task create and edit works with required validation.
Task status transitions are auditable and reversible where allowed.
Assigned users see updates within five seconds online.

features.title: Offline-first local cache
features.description: Core entities remain usable offline and synchronize safely.
acceptance_criteria: Users can create and update tasks while offline.
Sync queue retries with exponential backoff.
Conflict resolution applies deterministic last-write policy.

features.title: Realtime updates
features.description: Task changes propagate in near real time across connected clients.
acceptance_criteria: Task list updates automatically when another user edits data.
Connection loss triggers graceful fallback and reconnect.
No duplicate events are rendered in UI.

features.title: Notifications and reminders
features.description: Users receive task assignment and due-date notifications.
acceptance_criteria: Push notifications are delivered to mobile devices.
In-app notifications are visible on web and desktop.
Notification preferences can disable specific event categories.

features.title: Audit trail
features.description: Critical actions are logged with actor, timestamp, and action details.
acceptance_criteria: Task status changes create immutable audit records.
Audit log query supports project and date filtering.
Non-admin users cannot access audit export.

features.title: Observability baseline
features.description: Core events and errors are traceable with logs, metrics, and traces.
acceptance_criteria: Structured logs include correlation IDs across services.
Core endpoint latency metrics are emitted with tags.
Unhandled exceptions are captured with stack traces.

features.title: CI quality gates
features.description: Pull requests are blocked unless all mandatory quality checks pass.
acceptance_criteria: Lint and typecheck are required status checks.
Unit and integration tests are required status checks.
Security scan failures block merge.

features.title: Release and rollback pipeline
features.description: Release artifacts are versioned, signed, and rollback-ready.
acceptance_criteria: Each release produces immutable artifacts with checksums.
Rollback command can restore previous stable version.
Release notes are generated from merged changes.
